messages.message: Hello! Thanks for contacting Nimbus Telecom. I'm Sana. How can I help you today?
hi, i have a problem with my bill. i was charged twice for the same service last month and its really annoying
I need your account number to access the details.
it is 41433295. my name is Vivek Brown
Thank you. Please provide your phone number and email for the record.
phone is 92859 63349 and email is vivek.68@examplemail.com
I see the duplicate charge of $15.00 on your statement.
yeah, so can you just fix it now? i dont want to pay for something i didnt use
I will raise a refund request for the wrong charge now.
great, so i'll get my money back today?
The refund is subject to approval and will take 7-10 business days to process.
what?? 10 days?? this is ridiculous. you guys messed up and now i have to wait weeks for my own money 😡
this is terrible service. i am so frustrated with how you're handling this!!
Is there anything else I can help you with? I have submitted the request and you will be notified via email. Goodbye.
